tiles: Floral motifs shaped by generative symmetry
Graceful ornament and luminous color fields
challenge: Interpreting art nouveau's flowing ornamental language through generative tools, finding the tension between perfect symmetry and organic asymmetry in floral compositions. The goal was to create decorative panels that feel alive and hand-crafted despite their digital origins, with luminous color and graceful line work.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to establish core symmetry and motif repetition for each floral composition. In-painting refined line weight and edge discipline to achieve art nouveau precision, while Lightroom handled color layering and luminosity to give each panel its distinctive glow.
result: Delivered a five-piece art nouveau floral collection with cohesive decorative panels that present cleanly in tile layouts and hold intricate ornamental detail at print resolution. The series bridges historical decorative arts with contemporary generative process.
